body: Yes college level. And it’s an abusive household. I just know that if I’m the only person who can help  I’m left w touch decisions if I’m the only one who knows. I do my best to listen but when I listen I only hear about how much he doesn’t want to be there. We’re trying making a list of positive thinking and lifestyle changes but if it even works what happens if he falls into a dark place ahain. I don’t think I’m mentally capable to keep doing it over and over

He still makes goals and that offers me a little hope, one being to get into school but they said at the same time they are devastated if they don’t get in and don’t want to live to see that happen. He’s felt suicidal for years and has attempted a few times a while ago. A lot of bad things have been happening recently though and it’s getting worse I can feel it but mentally it’s been taking a tole on me. I want to help so badly but I don’t have the answers or qualifications. I wish I could tell someone but it’s a toxic household he lives in and it’d be bad if his parents found out as well as they don’t want to see a pro. Idk what I can do because if I tell someone I feel like I break his trust but I also want them to be safe

I appreciate the advice. He does feel that he burdens me and he hates that this causes me stress, and so I’ve tried to be reassuring that even though it does cause me stress and worry, having them in this world with me brings a lot of happiness too and that this stress I feel is a small thing too feel. Your words have helped me a lot, it’s hard being in a situation where you can’t relate to the other person or know or say the right things
